name: EEA air quality download service (Parquet, E1a up-to-date measurements)
gives: hourly measurements of PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3 and other pollutants from member-state monitoring stations, including Portugal, as Parquet files per station

why.quote: Information, documents and material available on this website and for which the EEA holds the rights of use are public and may be re-used without prior permission, free of charge, for commercial or non-commercial purposes, provided that the EEA is always acknowledged as the original source of the material and that the original meaning or message of the content is not distorted.
why.basis: EEA legal notice (re-use policy; it adds that certain data may carry different conditions); robots.txt on the API host returns 404 (no rules); on www.eea.europa.eu robots disallows /api, which is a different host and path

interface: OpenAPI at https://eeadmz1-downloads-api-appservice.azurewebsites.net/swagger/v1/swagger.json. POST /ParquetFile/urls with JSON {countries, cities, pollutants, dataset (2 = up-to-date E1a), source 'Api', dateTimeStart, dateTimeEnd} returns a list of Parquet file URLs on eeadmz1batchservice02.blob.core.windows.net. No key.
notes: Keyless; probed once on 2026-11-18 (Portugal, PM10, one day) and it returned Portuguese station file URLs. Parquet needs a reader (pyarrow or DuckDB) and files are per station, so a collector would aggregate to a small JSON per city. Data is validated or near-real-time as the member states report it, so expect delays. Dataset-level licence not read (gap). Rate limits not found. London and UK stations are in the EEA data only up to the UK's reporting; not checked. A map-service host (discomap.eea.europa.eu) returned 404 on robots.txt and was not used.
